appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Year vs. Mortality rate'.
Y-axis scale ranges from 0 to 8, with tick marks at 0, 2, 4, 6, and 8.
X-axis scale spans years from 2006 to 2018, with labeled ticks at 2006, 2008, 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, and 2018.
The data line is blue, with circular markers at each data point.
The data point for 2010 is located at approximately 8.0 on the y-axis.
The data point for 2018 is located at approximately 7.5 on the y-axis.

public_definitions: Review the annual mortality surveillance dashboard and route the year that should receive peak-burden follow-up.
Use the yearly mortality trend in the chart to determine which reporting year warrants escalation, then select the corresponding routing option.
